name: Realm of Oblivion
descriptionTemplate: Sanga gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: Tentacle Limit +1. Shield generated by Sanga +[Arg3]%. Each time Sanga generates Shield, {Tentacle DMG} +[TentaclePower:Arg2].
lore:
"The stars and Kadath are ready. Oh chosen kin, you shall shine with rebirth..."
From that moment on, her art had only one motif.
She indulged herself in the rapture of madness; she wept quietly in a dream.
